oliver: Pinging the group — onboarding sampleapp hit an odd one: embed-batcher + auth retry + protobuf encoder -> server rejects with vector_dim_mismatch. Feels different from the usual DEFAULT_DIM fallback.

mei: quick details? which SDK/version and helper config?

oliver: Node `@redwood/inference` v0.8.6, using embed-batcher with pad_to_multiple:4. The wrinkle: our batch helper serializes padded zeros using a compact protobuf repeated-float encoding that the server-side validator reads length from metadata (vec_len). On retry, the helper re-encodes but a different float packing path changed the vec_len header to 1280 instead of 1024, so server complains.

samir: that's new — earlier bugs centered on fallback dims. Can you paste the two raw request bodies (hex or debug) if possible?

oliver: minimal repro (sanitized):

Request A (first attempt, 200):
```json
{"items":[{"id":"x","text":"foo"}],"batching":{"pad_to_multiple":4}}
```
Server accepted and returned model=open-embed-1024.

Request B (retry after token refresh -> 400): helper sent a protobuf body with a vec_len header of 1280 while the repeated float payload actually contained 1024 floats (zeros + values). Server error: {"error":{"code":"vector_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 1024 got 1280"}}

mei: so this is an encoding mismatch, not a dimension constant. Any parity differences across SDKs?

oliver: Python and Go both use a stable JSON path (no protobuf) and unaffected. Rust SDK uses an older protobuf lib that produced consistent headers; Node recently switched to a newer buffer writer for retries which seems to add padding bytes in header computation.

darnell: action items: (1) short-term: disable protobuf compact path for Node retry (fallback to JSON encode) in the helper; (2) longer-term: add a test matrix for encoding parity across SDKs (json vs protobuf) and ensure server validator tolerates encoded-header+payload combos or verifies by actual float count not header only; (3) add a unit test that simulates token refresh that triggers the alternate encoder path.

samir: also add a quick mitigation in sampleapp README: set pad_to_multiple:1 or set REDWOOD_EMBED_ENCODER=stable-json to avoid the compact path.

oliver: opened GH issue with logs + hexdumps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/678 "embed-batcher: retry protobuf header mismatch causes vector_dim_mismatch". Attached captures and suggested test.

devex-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#678 by oliver - "embed-batcher: retry protobuf header mismatch causes vector_dim_mismatch".

darnell: I'll draft a patch to make the helper use call-scoped encoder selection and to add a validation step before sending retry (recompute vec_len from float count).

oliver: thanks — will try the stable-json workaround and report back. Leaving the thread for the PR follow-up. :thumbsup:
